_: Every release asset the Setup or the Builder downloads, pinned: the one list (installer's release_publish.py refuses a draft that lacks an asset pinned to its own tag, or an asset pinned to an earlier tag that is not live there with this sha256). tag = the release that really carries the file (an unchanged file stays on the release that first carried it; never 'latest'). used_by: builder:<NAME> = builder.py's NAME, setup:<Key> = make_setup.py bakes it into the Setup (Release.<Key>Asset / Tag / Sha256; it checks the zip it builds has this sha256, --repin rewrites the entry).
